package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

type OnboardingPathAdmissionRepository interface {
	Reserve(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathAdmissionRequest, string, string, time.Time, time.Duration) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error)
	Renew(context.Context, string, string, int64, string, string, time.Time, time.Duration) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error)
	Materialize(context.Context, string, domain.OnboardingPathMaterialization, string, string, string, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingPathMaterializationResult, bool, error)
	Abort(context.Context, string, domain.OnboardingPathAbort, string, string, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error)
	HasLiveOnboardingPathAdmission(context.Context, string) (bool, error)
}
